Mahomes vs. Allen NFL MVP Debate Continues After Week 2

Despite Patrick Mahomes leading Week 2 in passing yards, analyst Nick Wright favors Josh Allen for NFL MVP. Allen has recorded nine touchdowns in the first two games of the season, with several analysts also favoring him for MVP. Mahomes is ranked second in MVP consideration behind Allen. Patrick Mahomes also set a unique NFL overtime record in Week 2 during the Chiefs' win against the Colts.
